title: Automating the data extraction process for systematic reviews using GPT-4o and o3

live_model.evidence: "Microsoft Azure OpenAI API (GPT-4o-2024-05-13), as well as the OpenAI API (o3-2025-04-16)"; Table 1: contextual chat prompting reaches 73.4% accuracy (chat-5-RCT).

prompt.location: Sec 2.6-2.7 (meta-prompt / contextual-chat / batch-DE method descriptions); Figure 6 (RCT/arm/variable flow)
prompt.note: Prompting strategies are named and described in detail; full literal prompt text not confirmed printed in the body reviewed.

claim.metric: Accuracy of numeric variable extraction (contextual chat prompting, chat-5-RCT), Dataset 1, 10-fold CV
claim.location: Table 1 ("the contextual chat prompting method achieved the highest accuracy of 73.4% when trained with five RCTs")

data.source: Published RCT reports (Dataset 1 from a January 2024 paper); source code at https://github.com/Tomo-for-lab/automating-DE

notes: Exact number of RCTs/arms/variables underlying the 10-fold cross-validation accuracy is given only via a flowchart (Figure 6), not as a clean printed N — the soft gap behind 'maybe'. o3-2025-04-16 is used only in a supplementary comparison ('to assess potential performance improvements'), same prompts/methodology, no separate headline number located. Dataset RCT source papers are public journal articles but not bundled/released as a single corpus by the authors.
